title: Houthis Claim Attack on Aramco Facilities; Saudi Coalition Calls Claim 'Misleading'
detail: Houthi forces claimed responsibility for an attack on Saudi Aramco oil facilities as the Yemen conflict continued to escalate, citing the strikes as retaliation for the Saudi-led coalition's military operations. The Saudi-led coalition dismissed the Houthi claim as 'misleading', characterizing it as propaganda intended to exaggerate the group's capabilities and impact on Saudi infrastructure.

media.caption: Houthis claim attack on Aramco facilities as Yemen conflict escalates
